title: Warnings, the Rich Fool, and Anxious Thoughts

questions.question: When a crowd of many thousands gathered, trampling one another, what did Jesus first warn His disciples to beware of?
options: The leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy
The leaven of Herod, which is pride
The swords of the Roman zealots
The false teachers selling doves
questions.correctAnswer: The leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy
questions.explanation: Luke 12:1 (ESV): "he began to say to his disciples first, 'Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.'"

questions.question: Jesus said, "I tell you, my friends, do not fear those who kill the body, and after that have nothing more that they can do." Whom should we fear instead?
options: "Fear him who, after he has killed, has authority to cast into hell."
"Fear the silent sin creeping at your door."
"Fear Satan, who prowls like a roaring lion."
"Fear only the loss of your immortal soul."
questions.correctAnswer: "Fear him who, after he has killed, has authority to cast into hell."
questions.explanation: Luke 12:5 (ESV): "But I will warn you whom to fear: fear him who, after he has killed, has authority to cast into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him!"

questions.question: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? And not one of them is forgotten before God. What does Jesus say about the hairs of your head?
options: "Why, even the hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not; you are of more value than many sparrows."
"Though your hairs turn white, God numbers every strand until the end."
"Let your hair wash my feet, for God knows your devotion."
"Your hair is numbered as the sands of the sea, yet you worry."
questions.correctAnswer: "Why, even the hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not; you are of more value than many sparrows."
questions.explanation: Luke 12:7 (ESV): "Why, even the hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not; you are of more value than many sparrows."

questions.question: What does Jesus say will happen to whoever denies Him before men?
options: "He also will be denied before the angels of God."
"He will be cast out of the synagogue on earth."
"He will spend a thousand years paying his debt."
"He will never taste the bread of life."
questions.correctAnswer: "He also will be denied before the angels of God."
questions.explanation: Luke 12:9 (ESV): "but the one who denies me before men will be denied before the angels of God."

questions.question: Jesus says that everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but the one who blasphemes against whom will not be forgiven?
options: The Holy Spirit
The Father in Heaven
The Law of Moses
The Temple of the Lord
questions.explanation: Luke 12:10 (ESV): "And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven."

questions.question: Someone from the crowd yelled, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me." Jesus warned the crowd to take care, and be on guard against what?
options: All covetousness, for one's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions
A greedy heart, for blood money cannot buy heaven
Lawyers who seek to destroy the peace of families
Anger that leads to murder
questions.correctAnswer: All covetousness, for one's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions
questions.explanation: Luke 12:15 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Take care, and be on your guard against all covetousness, for one's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.'"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Rich Fool, a rich man's land produced so plentifully that he had nowhere to store his crops. What did he decide to do?
options: Tear down his barns and build larger ones to store all his grain and goods
Share half of his harvest with the poor outside his gates
Burn the surplus so the market price would stay high
Pay extra taxes ahead of time so Caesar would favor him
questions.correctAnswer: Tear down his barns and build larger ones to store all his grain and goods
questions.explanation: Luke 12:18 (ESV): "And he said, 'I will do this: I will tear down my barns and build larger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.'"

questions.question: What did God say to the rich man after he built his new barns?
options: "Fool! This night your soul is required of you, and the things you have prepared, whose will they be?"
"Wise investor, for you shall live for many seasons in peace."
"You have robbed the poor; tomorrow thieves will empty your barns."
"Woe to you, for you did not thank me."
questions.correctAnswer: "Fool! This night your soul is required of you, and the things you have prepared, whose will they be?"
questions.explanation: Luke 12:20 (ESV): "But God said to him, 'Fool! This night your soul is required of you, and the things you have prepared, whose will they be?'"

questions.question: Jesus teaches His disciples: "Therefore I tell you, do not be anxious about your life, what you will eat, nor about your body, what you will put on." For life is more than what?
options: Food, and the body more than clothing
Breath, and the heart more than gold
Waiting for tomorrow, and labor more than sleep
The days given, and the house built
questions.correctAnswer: Food, and the body more than clothing
questions.explanation: Luke 12:23 (ESV): "For life is more than food, and the body more than clothing."

questions.question: Jesus asks them to consider which birds, that neither sow nor reap, nor have storehouse or barn, yet God feeds them?
options: The ravens
The sparrows
The eagles
The doves
questions.explanation: Luke 12:24 (ESV): "Consider the ravens: they neither sow nor reap, they have neither storehouse nor barn, and yet God feeds them."

questions.question: Jesus tells them to consider the lilies, how they grow. Even who, in all his glory, was not arrayed like one of these?
options: Solomon
David
Herod
Caesar
questions.explanation: Luke 12:27 (ESV): "Consider the lilies, how they grow... yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these."

questions.question: "Provide yourselves with moneybags that do not grow old, with a treasure in the heavens that does not fail... For where your treasure is..."?
options: "...there will your heart be also."
"...there you will settle your debts forever."
"...there the thieves cannot find it."
"...so shall your rewards be given."
questions.explanation: Luke 12:34 (ESV): "For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also."

questions.question: Jesus commands them to stay dressed for action and keep their lamps burning, waiting like men for their master to do what?
options: To come home from the wedding feast
To bring them wages at the end of the day
To return from battle with victory spoils
To wake from a long sleep in the palace
questions.correctAnswer: To come home from the wedding feast
questions.explanation: Luke 12:36 (ESV): "and be like men who are waiting for their master to come home from the wedding feast, so that they may open the door to him at once when he comes and knocks."

questions.question: What is the terrifying consequence for the servant who says "My master is delayed in coming," beats the other servants, and gets drunk?
options: The master will come on an unknown day, cut him in pieces and put him with the unfaithful
He will be fired and tossed out of the house into poverty
He will be beaten with seventy stripes on his back
He will be chained to the wall of the wine cellar
questions.correctAnswer: The master will come on an unknown day, cut him in pieces and put him with the unfaithful
questions.explanation: Luke 12:46 (ESV): "the master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he does not know, and will cut him in pieces and put him with the unfaithful."

questions.question: Jesus said, "Everyone to whom much was given, of him much will be required." What did He say He came to cast upon the earth?
options: Fire, and would that it were already kindled!
A sword to divide family members perfectly
Water, to quench the anger of the nations
Seeds of peace to quiet the coming storm
questions.correctAnswer: Fire, and would that it were already kindled!
questions.explanation: Luke 12:49 (ESV): "I came to cast fire on the earth, and would that it were already kindled!"

key_verse_text: "For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also."
